sentences.en: Today, the Times gets Donald Trump Jr.'s emails about an offer from the Russian government.
sentences.zh: 今天，《纽约时报》获得了小唐纳德·特朗普关于俄罗斯政府提供信息的电子邮件。

sentences.en: I love it, he wrote.
sentences.zh: “我太喜欢了，”他写道。

sentences.en: And what ISIS left behind.
sentences.zh: 以及 ISIS 留下了什么。

sentences.en: The streets of Mosul in the hours after the Iraqi government declared victory over the Islamic State.
sentences.zh: 伊拉克政府宣布战胜伊斯兰国数小时后的摩苏尔街道。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, July 12th.
sentences.zh: 今天是 7 月 12 日，星期三。

sentences.en: Matt Apuso, it's Tuesday morning in The Times newsroom.
sentences.zh: 马特·阿普索，现在是《时报》新闻编辑部的星期二早晨。

sentences.en: What's happening?
sentences.zh: 发生什么事了？

sentences.en: We've got the emails, right?
sentences.zh: 我们拿到邮件了，对吧？

sentences.en: We've been searching for these emails for days.
sentences.zh: 我们已经寻找这些邮件好几天了。

sentences.en: These are the emails between Donald Trump Jr.
sentences.zh: 这些是小唐纳德·特朗普

sentences.en: and Rob Goldstone, the friend who is going to set up this meeting at
sentences.zh: 与罗布·戈德斯坦之间的电子邮件，罗布是那个要在

sentences.en: Trump Tower with a Russian lawyer.
sentences.zh: 特朗普大厦安排这场与俄罗斯女律师会面的朋友。

sentences.en: We're calling around and we're asking people for comment.
sentences.zh: 我们四处致电，请大家置评。

sentences.en: And that means, of course, we call Don Jr.
sentences.zh: 这意味着，当然，我们要打电话给小唐

sentences.en: and say, we have the emails.
sentences.zh: 并说，我们有邮件了。

sentences.en: We want your comment.
sentences.zh: 我们需要你的评论。

sentences.en: And we're going to publish.
sentences.zh: 而且我们要发表了。

sentences.en: Your deadline is 11 a.m.
sentences.zh: 你的截止时间是上午 11 点。

sentences.en: So he understands that 11 o'clock, boom, this big story is going to land.
sentences.zh: 所以他明白 11 点整，轰的一声，这篇重磅报道就要发布了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: There's no question.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问。

sentences.en: We told him we have to have a comment.
sentences.zh: 我们告诉他我们必须有回应。

sentences.en: And this shouldn't have been a surprise, right?
sentences.zh: 这不应该是个意外吧？

sentences.en: They must have known somebody was going to get the emails.
sentences.zh: 他们肯定知道有人会拿到这些邮件。

sentences.en: So we said, you have until 11.
sentences.zh: 所以我们说，你到 11 点前都有时间。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And then what happens?
sentences.zh: 然后发生了什么？

sentences.en: Well, then he started tweeting, right?
sentences.zh: 嗯，然后他开始发推特了，对吧？

sentences.en: Then he goes on Twitter and starts publishing the emails himself.
sentences.zh: 然后他上推特，开始自己公开发布这些邮件。

sentences.en: And he did that at 11 a.m., the deadline.
sentences.zh: 他在上午 11 点，也就是截止时间做了这件事。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Which means he was trying to self-publish around the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 这意味着他试图在《纽约时报》之前自我发布。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: And I mean, that's right.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，确实如此。

sentences.en: I mean, he had said he would send us a statement and he did.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他曾说过他会给我们发送一份声明，他也这么做了。

sentences.en: He also sent the world a statement, which it wasn't beyond the realm of possibility.
sentences.zh: 他还向世界发送了一份声明，这并非完全不可能发生的事。

sentences.en: And it was certainly not something we hadn't considered.
sentences.zh: 这当然也是我们考虑过的情况。

sentences.en: I mean, the idea that Don Jr.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，小唐

sentences.en: would be on Twitter is certainly a realistic assumption of how this could go.
sentences.zh: 会上推特发声，绝对是对此事发展的一种现实假设。

sentences.en: So we had a story that was essentially ready to go.
sentences.zh: 所以我们有一篇基本上随时可以发表的报道。

sentences.en: As soon as the tweet started coming, we published.
sentences.zh: 推特刚一出现，我们就发表了。

sentences.en: And I don't even think he had finished tweeting out the string of emails before we published.
sentences.zh: 而且我想在他发完那一连串推特之前，我们就已经发表了。

sentences.en: So, Matt, what does this email from Rob Goldstone to Donald Trump Jr.
sentences.zh: 那么，马特，罗布·戈德斯坦发给小唐纳德·特朗普的这封邮件

sentences.en: say?
sentences.zh: 说了什么？

sentences.en: It was June 3rd, 2016, 1036 a.m.
sentences.zh: 那是 2016 年 6 月 3 日上午 10 点 36 分。

sentences.en: Good morning.
sentences.zh: 早上好。

sentences.en: Amen just called and asked me to contact you with something very interesting.
sentences.zh: 阿明刚刚打电话让我联系你，说有一件非常有趣的事。

sentences.en: The crown prosecutor of Russia met with his father, Aris, this morning and in their meeting offered to provide the Trump campaign with some official documents and information that
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯总检察长今天早上会见了其父亲阿里斯，并在会面中提出向特朗普竞选团队提供一些官方文件和信息，

sentences.en: would incriminate Hillary and her dealings with Russia and would be very useful to your father.
sentences.zh: 这些信息将起诉希拉里及其与俄罗斯的交易，对你父亲非常有用。

sentences.en: This is obviously very high level and sensitive information, but is part of Russia and its government support for Mr. Trump, helped along by Aris and Amen.
sentences.zh: 这显然是极高层且敏感的信息，但这是俄罗斯及其政府对特朗普先生支持的一部分，由阿里斯和阿明推动。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: What do you think is the best way to handle this information?
sentences.zh: 你认为处理这些信息的最佳方式是什么？

sentences.en: And would you be able to speak to Amen about it directly?
sentences.zh: 你是否能直接与阿明谈谈这件事？

sentences.en: I can also send this info to your father via Rona, but it is ultra sensitive.
sentences.zh: 我也可以通过罗娜把这些信息发给你父亲，但这是超级敏感的。

sentences.en: So, wanted to send to you firSt. Best, Rob Goldstone.
sentences.zh: 所以，想先发给你。祝好，罗布·戈德斯坦。

sentences.en: That's a hell of an email.
sentences.zh: 这真是一封了不得的邮件。

sentences.en: So, how long did it take for Donald Jr.
sentences.zh: 那么，小唐纳德花了几分钟

sentences.en: to reply?
sentences.zh: 才回复？

sentences.en: Minutes.
sentences.zh: 几分钟。

sentences.en: And he's right on his email.
sentences.zh: 他回邮件很迅速。

sentences.en: If it's what you say, I love it, especially later in the summer.
sentences.zh: 如果像你说的，我太喜欢了，尤其是今年夏天晚些时候。

sentences.en: So, Don Jr.'s response is, I love this information.
sentences.zh: 所以，小唐的回应是，我喜欢这个信息。

sentences.en: And in particular, I love it if it's available later in the year, in the summer.
sentences.zh: 特别是，如果能在今年晚些时候的夏天获得，那就更好了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Because, of course, that's peak campaign time, right?
sentences.zh: 因为，当然，那是竞选的高峰期，对吧？

sentences.en: You know, you get a bigger bump for damaging information.
sentences.zh: 你知道，破坏性的信息会带来更大的声势。

sentences.en: And they agree that Don Jr.
sentences.zh: 他们同意小唐

sentences.en: will take a meeting at Trump Tower.
sentences.zh: 将在特朗普大厦进行会面。

sentences.en: And a Russian government lawyer will fly from Moscow and meet him at Trump Tower.
sentences.zh: 而一名俄罗斯政府律师将从莫斯科飞往特朗普大厦与他会面。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So, that's what we know now, which is entirely different than the story Don Jr.
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是我们现在所知道的，这与周六《时报》开始报道此事时小唐

sentences.en: originally told when the Times began reporting this story on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 最初讲述的故事完全不同。

sentences.en: Back then, he was describing this meeting as being about a U.S.
sentences.zh: 当时，他将这次会面描述为关于美国

sentences.en: adoption program that this Russian lawyer objected to.
sentences.zh: 收养计划，而这位俄罗斯律师对此表示反对。

sentences.en: What is
sentences.zh: 现在小唐

sentences.en: Don Jr.
sentences.zh: 怎么说

sentences.en: saying about it now?
sentences.zh: 这件事？

sentences.en: Well, I think he's saying, hey, we're in the middle of a campaign.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想他是说，嘿，我们正处于竞选之中。

sentences.en: Somebody calls and offers me information.
sentences.zh: 有人打电话来提供信息。

sentences.en: Of course, I'm going to listen.
sentences.zh: 当然，我会听。

sentences.en: It's politics.
sentences.zh: 这就是政治。

sentences.en: Any candidate would always listen to somebody who says he's got damaging information about a candidate.
sentences.zh: 任何候选人都总是会听取那些声称拥有关于某位候选人之负面信息的人的话。

sentences.en: Even from the Russian government?
sentences.zh: 即使来自俄罗斯政府？

sentences.en: Well, so the most innocent explanation here, right, is if you're in the Trump campaign and
sentences.zh: 嗯，这里最无辜的解释，对吧，就是如果你在特朗普阵营并且

sentences.en: you say, we had no idea that the Russian government was in the midst of a hacking and propaganda campaign, then I can just take a meeting and ask for gossip.
sentences.zh: 你说，我们完全不知道俄罗斯政府正在进行黑客攻击和宣传战，那么我就可以去开个会，打听点八卦。

sentences.en: And only now, suddenly, everything
sentences.zh: 直到现在，突然之间，所有

sentences.en: Russian looks nefarious.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯相关的事情看起来都像是恶意的。

sentences.en: That's the most charitable read on all this.
sentences.zh: 这是对此事最宽容的解读。

sentences.en: Right, right, right.
sentences.zh: 对，对，对。

sentences.en: The phrase Russian government didn't mean what it means now.
sentences.zh: “俄罗斯政府”这个词并不意味着它现在的含义。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I think there's something to be said for that argument.
sentences.zh: 我认为这种说法也有一定道理。

sentences.en: The problem is, is that the story keeps changing, right?
sentences.zh: 问题在于，这个故事一直在变，对吧？

sentences.en: The story keeps changing from nobody had any contacts with the
sentences.zh: 故事一直在变：从没有人与

sentences.en: Russians to, okay, there were some contacts with the Russians, but they've all been disclosed.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯人有过任何接触，到好吧，确实与俄罗斯人有一些接触，但都已公开。

sentences.en: And think about the number of people in the Trump world who have had to belatedly disclose
sentences.zh: 想想特朗普世界里有多少人不得不迟迟披露

sentences.en: their contacts with somebody from Russia, whether it's Jeff Sessions, the attorney general.
sentences.zh: 他们与俄罗斯人的接触，无论是总检察长杰夫·塞申斯。

sentences.en: Attorney general Jeff Sessions did not disclose meetings he had last year with Russian officials when he applied for a security clearance.
sentences.zh: 总检察长杰夫·塞申斯在申请安全许可时，没有披露他去年与俄罗斯官员的会面。

sentences.en: Whether it's Michael Flynn, who resigned slash was fired as national security advisor.
sentences.zh: 无论是迈克尔·弗林，他辞职或被解除了国家安全顾问职务。

sentences.en: Stepping down Monday night in a firestorm of criticism.
sentences.zh: 周一晚上在狂风暴雨般的批评声中下台。

sentences.en: Jared Kushner, the president's son-in-law.
sentences.zh: 贾里德·库什纳，总统的女婿。

sentences.en: Jared Kushner and Russia's ambassador to Washington discussed the possibility of setting up a secret
sentences.zh: 贾里德·库什纳与俄罗斯驻华盛顿大使讨论了建立秘密

sentences.en: and secure communications channel between Trump's transition team and the Kremlin.
sentences.zh: 且安全的特朗普过渡团队与克里姆林宫之间通信渠道的可能性。

sentences.en: Paul Manafort, the campaign chairman.
sentences.zh: 保罗·马纳福特，竞选主席。

sentences.en: Paul Manafort secretly worked for a Russian billionaire to advance the interests of Russian
sentences.zh: 十年前，保罗·马纳福特曾秘密为一个俄罗斯亿万富翁工作，以推进俄罗斯

sentences.en: President Vladimir Putin a decade ago.
sentences.zh: 总统弗拉基米尔·普京的利益。

sentences.en: So, I mean, it's just where we are today in 2017, knowing what we know about the Russian government's efforts to tip the election.
sentences.zh: 所以，我的意思是，这就是我们今天在 2017 年所处的位置，了解我们对俄罗斯政府操纵大选努力的了解。

sentences.en: It's made worse by the sort of repeatedly changing stories.
sentences.zh: 由于这种反复变化的故事，情况变得更糟了。

sentences.en: So back to the players.
sentences.zh: 所以回到这些人物身上。

sentences.en: What is the Russian lawyer who was in the meeting saying now about it?
sentences.zh: 参加会议的那位俄罗斯律师现在对此有何说法？

sentences.en: So she denies any sort of connection to the Kremlin or Russia's efforts to meddle in the election.
sentences.zh: 所以她否认与克里姆林宫或俄罗斯干预大选的努力有任何联系。

sentences.en: She denies being a conduit for any information.
sentences.zh: 她否认自己是任何信息的传达渠道。

sentences.en: She says she came to do what she has basically been doing all along, which is trying to get
sentences.zh: 她说她来做她基本上一直在做的事情，那就是试图让

sentences.en: the American government to repeal the Magnitsky Act, a law issuing sanctions on Russia over human rights abuses.
sentences.zh: 美国政府废除《马格尼茨基法案》，这是一项因侵犯人权而对俄罗斯实施制裁的法律。

sentences.en: So why would Rob Goldstone represent her, as he did in his email to Donald Jr., as showing up with information from the Russian government that would hurt Hillary Clinton?
sentences.zh: 那么，为什么罗布·戈德斯坦会在写给小唐纳德的电子邮件中，把她描述为带着来自俄罗斯政府、会伤害希拉里·克林顿的信息出现的人呢？

sentences.en: I mean, it doesn't seem like he would have much to gain from misrepresenting her, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他似乎不会从歪曲她的身份中获得太多好处，对吧？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: We don't know the answer.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道答案。

sentences.en: We do know that this was being passed through several layers, right?
sentences.zh: 我们确实知道这经过了好几个环节的传递，对吧？

sentences.en: So was it a game of telephone?
sentences.zh: 所以这是传话游戏吗？

sentences.en: Was it a bit of puffery on Goldstone's part?
sentences.zh: 这算不算是戈德斯坦的一种吹嘘？

sentences.en: Or was it true?
sentences.zh: 还是说这是真的？

sentences.en: And this was a back channel.
sentences.zh: 而这是一个后门渠道。

sentences.en: This is what a back channel looks like.
sentences.zh: 这就是后门渠道的样子。

sentences.en: Somebody in one place wants to get information somewhere else, but doesn't want to have their hands on it.
sentences.zh: 某个地方的人想要获取其他地方的信息，但又不想自己沾手。

sentences.en: And they say, okay, well, you know so-and-so who knows the people I need to get this information to.
sentences.zh: 于是他们说，好吧，你知道那个认识我需要获取信息的人的某某吗？

sentences.en: Can you be a conduit for that?
sentences.zh: 你能为此充当传话筒吗？

sentences.en: So if information was passed, this is what a back channel looks like.
sentences.zh: 所以如果信息被传递了，这就是后门渠道的样子。

sentences.en: But they deny that any information was passed, and we don't have any evidence that it was.
sentences.zh: 但他们否认任何信息被传递，我们也没有任何证据证明曾有信息传递。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Both sides.
sentences.zh: 双方都是。

sentences.en: The Russian lawyer as well as Don Jr.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯律师以及小唐。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And look, there's some circumstantial evidence to back that up.
sentences.zh: 而且你看，有一些间接证据可以支持这一点。

sentences.en: We know that Paul Manafort, the campaign chairman, and Jared Kushner, the president's son-in-law, were also in the meeting.
sentences.zh: 我们知道竞选主席保罗·马纳福特和总统的女婿贾里德·库什纳也出席了会议。

sentences.en: We know that one of them left early, like within 10 minutes of the meeting started.
sentences.zh: 我们知道其中一人很早就离开了，比如会议开始后大约10分钟内。

sentences.en: It was just gone.
sentences.zh: 就这么不见了。

sentences.en: Now, if she were in there dishing dirt on Hillary Clinton- You might stay.
sentences.zh: 现在，如果她当时在那里说希拉里·克林顿的坏话——你可能会留下来。

sentences.en: What are the chances you'd just be like, hey, I got to go.
sentences.zh: 你觉得你会直接说“嘿，我得走了”的几率有多大？

sentences.en: I got that five o'clock.
sentences.zh: 我五点有事。

sentences.en: So Matt, as someone who's been covering all of this for months, the ties between the campaign
sentences.zh: 那么马特，作为一名几个月来一直在报道这一切的记者，竞选团队与俄罗斯之间的联系，

sentences.en: and Russia, how big of a deal is this development?
sentences.zh: 这一进展有多大影响？

sentences.en: I think it's a really big deal because we now have a document saying there was a Russian government effort to help Donald Trump that somebody in the closest circles of the Trump
sentences.zh: 我认为这影响非常重大，因为我们现在有了一份文件，表明俄罗斯政府曾试图帮助唐纳德·特朗普，

sentences.en: campaign knew about and was willing to accept that help.
sentences.zh: 而特朗普竞选团队最核心圈子里有人对此知情，并愿意接受这种帮助。

sentences.en: Now, whether that help came or not, we now know those things for certain.
sentences.zh: 现在，不管这种帮助有没有到来，我们对这些事情现在都可以确定了。

sentences.en: And that, Matt, brings us to a very familiar crossroads and a question I've asked you and several of our colleagues many times.
sentences.zh: 马特，这把我们带到了一个非常熟悉的十字路口，这也是我曾多次问过你和我们几位同事的问题。

sentences.en: Given what you just outlined, the offer, the explicit nature of a connection with the Russian government and the enthusiasm for accepting it, are we talking about collusion?
sentences.zh: 鉴于你刚才概述的内容——这种提议、与俄罗斯政府建立联系的明确性质以及接受这种联系的热情，我们是在谈论勾结吗？

sentences.en: I kind of want to demystify the word collusion here.
sentences.zh: 我其实想在这里厘清“勾结”这个词的含义。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: That word doesn't have power.
sentences.zh: 这个词其实没什么实质分量。

sentences.en: Collusion isn't a crime, right?
sentences.zh: 勾结不是犯罪，对吧？

sentences.en: Collusion is just kind of a shorthand way people in Washington have described the question of,
sentences.zh: 勾结只是华盛顿的人们用来描述这样一种问题的简便说法：

sentences.en: did anybody from the Trump campaign work with the Russian government to hurt Hillary Clinton?
sentences.zh: 特朗普竞选团队中是否有人与俄罗斯政府合作来抹黑希拉里·克林顿？

sentences.en: Now, was it legal?
sentences.zh: 这合法吗？

sentences.en: Was it illegal?
sentences.zh: 这违法吗？

sentences.en: Was there computer crime, foreign bribery?
sentences.zh: 其中是否存在计算机犯罪或海外行贿？

sentences.en: All that other legal stuff is separate from the question.
sentences.zh: 所有这些其他的法律问题都是独立于这个核心问题之外的。

sentences.en: When you hear somebody talk about collusion, all you're basically asking is, was anybody from the Trump campaign in on it?
sentences.zh: 当听到有人谈论勾结时，你基本上要问的就是：特朗普竞选团队里有人参与其中吗？

sentences.en: And that is a separate question from, did anybody in the Trump campaign break the law?
sentences.zh: 这与“特朗普竞选团队中是否有人违法”是一个独立的问题。

sentences.en: So just don't confuse collusion and, I got it, collusion.
sentences.zh: 所以，不要把勾结混为一谈——我懂，就是勾结。

sentences.en: Now everybody goes to jail.
sentences.zh: 现在每个人都要入狱了。

sentences.en: Just, that's not how this works.
sentences.zh: 事情根本不是这样的。

sentences.en: Matt, if collusion, as you just smartly suggested, is not a crime, why is that the word that keeps being used?
sentences.zh: 马特，正如你刚才精辟地指出的那样，既然勾结不是犯罪，为什么这个词还一直在被使用？

sentences.en: Are you telling me we should basically retire it?
sentences.zh: 你是说我们基本上应该不再使用它了吗？

sentences.en: I mean, well, because conspiracy has such a, you know, so much baggage to it, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，嗯，因为“阴谋”这个词带有太多的包袱，你知道的，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, what we're really talking about is, I, as a reporter, am far less interested in trying to build a case.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们真正讨论的是——作为一名记者，我对试图构建一个案件的兴趣要小得多。

sentences.en: I'm actually not at all interested in building a case where somebody can point to an article in the New York Times and say, see, there is the evidence that will be used in such and
sentences.zh: 我其实一点兴趣都没有去构建这样一个案件：有人可以指着《纽约时报》的一篇文章说，看，这就是将用于某某起诉书的证据。

sentences.en: such indictment.
sentences.zh: 起诉书。

sentences.en: That's not, like, that's not what I do.
sentences.zh: 那不是——那不是我的工作方式。

sentences.en: And it's not also what I think the role of a journalist is.
sentences.zh: 这也并非我认为记者应当扮演的角色。

sentences.en: So the question that drives me is, we know that the Russian government tried to mess around in the election.
sentences.zh: 因此，驱动我的问题是：我们知道俄罗斯政府试图插手这次选举。

sentences.en: And so was anybody around the Trump campaign working kind of on the side to help that?
sentences.zh: 那么，特朗普竞选团队周围是否有人在暗中配合以提供帮助？

sentences.en: It is a question about who's working behind the scenes to tip the balance of our democracy.
sentences.zh: 这是一个关于谁在幕后操纵以倾斜我们民主天平的问题。

sentences.en: That's the question we're working with right now.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们目前正在探讨的问题。

sentences.en: The story of the 2016 election is still being written.
sentences.zh: 2016年大选的故事仍在书写中。

sentences.en: Matt, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 马特，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: I appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我很感激。

sentences.en: I love it.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢了。

sentences.en: At what point did the president discuss with Donald Trump Jr.
sentences.zh: 总统是在什么时候与小唐纳德·特朗普讨论那次会议的？

sentences.en: that meeting?
sentences.zh: 随着整个事件不断发展，你是否有机会了解他对这件事的整体感受？

sentences.en: Have you had a chance to get a sense of what he feels about this entire story as it continues to unfold?
sentences.zh: 随着整个事件不断发展，你是否有机会了解他对这件事的整体感受？

sentences.en: On Tuesday, President Trump finally responded to the reporting in the Times through his White
sentences.zh: 周二，特朗普总统终于通过白宫女发言人萨拉·赫卡比·桑德斯回应了《纽约时报》的报道。

sentences.en: House spokeswoman, Sarah Huckabee Sanders.
sentences.zh: 白宫女发言人萨拉·赫卡比·桑德斯。

sentences.en: I have a quick statement that I'll read from the president.
sentences.zh: 我有一份简短的声明，我将代总统宣读。

sentences.en: My son is a high quality person, and I applaud his transparency.
sentences.zh: 我儿子是一个品格高尚的人，我为他的透明度感到赞赏。

sentences.en: And beyond that, I'm going to have to refer everything on this matter to John Jr.'s counsel and outside counsel and won't have anything else to add beyond that today.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，关于此事的所有问题，我只能请大家去咨询小约翰的法律顾问以及外部法律顾问，今天我不会再作任何补充。

sentences.en: A few hours later, Donald Trump Jr.
sentences.zh: 几个小时后，小唐纳德·特朗普

sentences.en: spoke to Sean Hannity of Fox News.
sentences.zh: 接受了福克斯新闻网肖恩·汉尼蒂的采访。

sentences.en: In retrospect, I probably would have done things a little differently.
sentences.zh: 回想起来，我当时可能会用稍微不同的方式来处理。

sentences.en: Again, this is before the Russia mania.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，这是在“通俄狂热”出现之前。

sentences.en: This is before they were building it up in the press.
sentences.zh: 这是在媒体炒作之前。

sentences.en: For me, this was opposition research.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这只是反对派调查。

sentences.en: They had something, you know, maybe concrete evidence to all the stories I'd been hearing about, but they were probably underreported for years, not just during the campaign.
sentences.zh: 他们掌握了一些东西，你知道的，也许是我一直听到但多年来一直被低估的各种传闻的实质证据，不仅仅是在竞选期间。

sentences.en: So I think I wanted to hear it out.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时想听听他们怎么说。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you, and you turned a DJ booth into this like
sentences.zh: 甚至在黑胶唱片时代的夜总会里当DJ时，你每晚都要带着300件你最珍视的宝贝去工作，你把DJ台变成了这样一个充满美丽50年历史文物的活生生的快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 生活中的快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重构者》。

sentences.en: Subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today, and get free access for
sentences.zh: 订阅《纽约时报》，立即下载时报应用程序，即可免费畅享30天。

sentences.en: 30 days.
In the days since Mosul was declared liberated from ISIS fighters, Rukmini Kalamaki has been
sentences.zh: 自从摩苏尔宣布从极端组织“伊斯兰国”武装分子手中解放出来以来，鲁克米尼·卡拉马基便一直深入其老城的街道，战斗的最后阶段正是在那里进行，随行的还有日常制片人安迪·米尔斯。

sentences.en: venturing into the streets of its old city, where the final stages of the battle were fought, along with daily producer Andy Mills.
sentences.zh: 战斗的最后阶段正是在那里进行，随行的还有日常制片人安迪·米尔斯。

sentences.en: What is the timeline of events that bring us from the beginning of the attempt to recapture the city until now?
sentences.zh: 从开始试图收复该城到现在，事件的时间线是怎样的？

sentences.en: So in the middle of October of last year.
sentences.zh: 所以在去年10月中旬。

sentences.en: The final push is on tonight to clear ISIS from what was its key stronghold, the city of Mosul.
sentences.zh: 今晚将发起最后冲刺，将“伊斯兰国”从其核心据点摩苏尔清除出去。

sentences.en: Iraqi and Kurdish troops descended on eastern Mosul and began the push to try to take back the city that at that point had a population that was larger than Philadelphia.
sentences.zh: 伊拉克和库尔德部队推进到摩苏尔东部，并开始发力试图收复这座当时人口比费城还要多的城市。

sentences.en: Iraqi and Kurdish forces have begun a military assault on the ISIL stronghold of Mosul in a battle some see as the jihadist group's last stand in Iraq.
sentences.zh: 伊拉克和库尔德部队对“伊斯兰国”据点摩苏尔发起了军事进攻，这场战斗被一些人视为该圣战组织在伊拉克的最后背水一战。

sentences.en: They pushed in, and they were able to liberate the eastern half of the city by this January.
sentences.zh: 他们长驱直入，并在今年1月前成功解放了该市的东半部。

sentences.en: Today we celebrate the feast of victory and liberation, the liberation of East Mosul.
sentences.zh: 今天我们庆祝胜利与解放的节日，东摩苏尔的解放。

sentences.en: But American-backed Iraqi forces are involved in fierce fighting with ISIS as they battle for the western half of Mosul.
sentences.zh: 但美军支持的伊拉克军队正在与“伊斯兰国”展开激烈的巷战，争夺摩苏尔的西半部。

sentences.en: The western side of the city, which was the second part of the battle, was the most difficult because that's the most dense part of the urban core.
sentences.zh: 作为战斗的第二部分，该市的西部是最艰难的，因为那是城市核心区人口最稠密的部分。

sentences.en: This is the old city.
sentences.zh: 这就是老城。

sentences.en: The streets are small.
sentences.zh: 街道狭窄。

sentences.en: The fighting there is house to house.
sentences.zh: 那里的战斗是逐屋进行的。

sentences.en: ISIS have littered it with booby traps and with mines.
sentences.zh: “伊斯兰国”在那里布满了诱饵弹和地雷。

sentences.en: And so now it's heavy urban guerrilla warfare.
sentences.zh: 所以现在这是残酷的城市游击战。

sentences.en: So the battle ended up being both much longer and far more violent and deathly than anybody expected.
sentences.zh: 因此，这场战斗最终比任何人预期的都要漫长得多，也暴力和致命得多。

sentences.en: The effort to drive ISIS out of Mosul is now in its sixth month.
sentences.zh: 将“伊斯兰国”驱逐出摩苏尔的行动目前已进入第六个月。

sentences.en: Casualty rates among some Iraqi units are at World War II levels.
sentences.zh: 某些伊拉克部队的伤亡率达到了第二次世界大战的水平。

sentences.en: A few thousand ISIS fighters pitted against tens of thousands of Iraqi troops and the full force of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 几千名“伊斯兰国”武装分子与数万名伊拉克军队以及美军联军的全力压制对抗。

sentences.en: coalition.
sentences.zh: 联军的全力压制对抗。

sentences.en: And two days ago.
sentences.zh: 就在两天前。

sentences.en: They're jubilant in Mosul.
sentences.zh: 摩苏尔一片欢腾。

sentences.en: They've driven the extremists out.
sentences.zh: 他们把极端分子赶出去了。

sentences.en: The Iraqi military declared victory.
sentences.zh: 伊拉克军方宣布取得胜利。

sentences.en: Today, Iraq's prime minister declared victory over ISIS in Mosul.
sentences.zh: 今天，伊拉克总理宣布在摩苏尔战胜了“伊斯兰国”。

sentences.en: But.
sentences.zh: 但是。

sentences.en: Hey, Huck.
sentences.zh: 嘿，哈克。

sentences.en: When you hear that, it's outgoing.
sentences.zh: 当你听到这个声音时，那是打出去的。

sentences.en: Outgoing.
sentences.zh: 打出去的炮火。

sentences.en: You and I were in the city on the day, in the moment when that news alert moved on our phone.
sentences.zh: 你和我当时就在城里，就在那条新闻快讯弹出的那一刻。

sentences.en: The New York Times just said the Iraqi government claimed Mosul has been taken.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》刚刚报道称伊拉克政府声称摩苏尔已被攻占。

sentences.en: And we could still hear airstrikes overhead and artillery and the tatatat of outgoing gunfire.
sentences.zh: 而我们头顶依然能听到空袭声、炮击声以及向外射击的哒哒枪声。

sentences.en: And we weren't allowed to even approach the front because the Iraqi military said that it was too dangerous.
sentences.zh: 我们甚至不被允许接近前线，因为伊拉克军方称那里太危险了。

sentences.en: The community is now climbing over pieces of what was once a tin roof, I believe.
sentences.zh: 社区居民现在正爬过曾经是铁皮屋顶的残骸，我想是的。

sentences.en: And there's a...
sentences.zh: 还有一个...

sentences.en: Hey, Smoke, you see this?
sentences.zh: 嘿，烟雾，你看到这个了吗？

sentences.en: That's close.
sentences.zh: 这很近。

sentences.en: And we're now on the second day after that declaration.
sentences.zh: 现在是发表该声明后的第二天。

sentences.en: It's still ongoing.
sentences.zh: 战斗仍在继续。

sentences.en: So, pockets of resistance remain.
sentences.zh: 所以，仍有零星抵抗力量残存。

sentences.en: So, we're parked on a narrow street in western Mosul.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们将车停在摩苏尔西部的一条窄街上。

sentences.en: The houses all around us have been destroyed.
sentences.zh: 我们周围的房屋全被摧毁了。

sentences.en: The windows have been blasted out, rubble everywhere, coils of rebar.
sentences.zh: 窗户被炸飞，到处都是瓦砾，还有一卷卷的钢筋。

sentences.en: Could you just describe for people what it is like walking around there?
sentences.zh: 你能向大家描述一下在那里行走是什么感觉吗？

sentences.en: We just opened the doors to the car and immediately you could smell the stench of dead bodies.
sentences.zh: 我们刚打开车门，立刻就能闻到尸体的恶臭。

sentences.en: The old city of Mosul looks like the scene of an earthquake.
sentences.zh: 摩苏尔老城看起来就像地震现场。

sentences.en: I mean, this is like, I don't know how to describe this.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这就像——我不知道该怎么形容。

sentences.en: I mean, like, every single thing on the street is destroyed.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，街上的每一样东西都被摧毁了。

sentences.en: Look at it.
sentences.zh: 你看它。

sentences.en: I mean, it's like...
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，就像……

sentences.en: I've never seen anything like it.
sentences.zh: 我从未见过这样的景象。

sentences.en: Every single building that we go by has been destroyed, collapsed, pancaked.
sentences.zh: 我们路过的每一栋建筑都被摧毁、坍塌、压扁了。

sentences.en: Oh my God, it's an enormous hole.
sentences.zh: 哦天哪，这是一个巨大的坑。

sentences.en: I mean, it looks like the foundation of a skyscraper.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，它看起来像摩天大楼的地基。

sentences.en: You walk past these enormous craters that are the size of, you know, maybe two stories, burrowed into the ground that mark the spots where Coalition bombs fell.
sentences.zh: 你走过这些巨大的弹坑，它们有两层楼那么大，深陷地下，标志着联军炸弹落下的地方。

sentences.en: There's a building that appears to have been airstriked and half of its facade has fallen off, but the other half is still holding.
sentences.zh: 有一栋建筑似乎遭到空袭，其一半的立面已经脱落，但另一半依然支撑着。

sentences.en: I mean, it literally looks like the pictures I saw, the black and white pictures I saw from
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，它看起来真的就像我见过的二战时期的黑白照片，

sentences.en: World War II, from Dresden, from Berlin, of these completely wiped out cities.
sentences.zh: 德累斯顿、柏林那些被彻底抹去的城市的照片。

sentences.en: I mean, there's juSt...
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这里只有……

sentences.en: I don't even know how you begin to rebuild this.
sentences.zh: 我甚至不知道你该如何开始重建这一切。

sentences.en: So you have this gray landscape of destruction and death.
sentences.zh: 所以你看到的是一片由毁灭和死亡组成的灰色景观。

sentences.en: Can you describe what we're seeing?
sentences.zh: 你能描述一下我们看到的情景吗？

sentences.en: It's a total market that's been leveled to the ground, or what's left of it is just like debris and there's nothing to be rebuilt.
sentences.zh: 这是一个被夷为平地的综合市场，或者说剩下的只是一片废墟，没有什么可以重建的了。

sentences.en: Who is Haq?
sentences.zh: 谁是哈克？

sentences.en: Haq is our translator and fixer and my friend, and he is from Mosul.
sentences.zh: 哈克是我们的翻译兼向导，也是我的朋友，他是摩苏尔人。

sentences.en: He grew up in the city.
sentences.zh: 他在这个城市长大。

sentences.en: He went to its university.
sentences.zh: 他曾在那里的大学上学。

sentences.en: He taught in its schools as a teacher before becoming a contractor for the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在成为美军的合同工、现在担任记者向导之前，他曾在当地学校当过老师。

sentences.en: military and now a fixer for journalists.
sentences.zh: 现在担任记者向导之前，他曾在当地学校当过老师。

sentences.en: So those dead bodies we just saw were human shields, probably?
sentences.zh: 所以我们刚才看到的那些尸体很可能是人肉盾牌？

sentences.en: Yeah, so used as biases.
sentences.zh: 是的，被当作人肉盾牌使用。

sentences.en: And he's been my guide, you know, on this journey.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他是这次行程中的向导。

sentences.en: For him, this is not just a story.
sentences.zh: 对他来说，这不仅仅是一个故事。

sentences.en: For him, this is the decimation of his hometown.
sentences.zh: 对他来说，这是他家乡的毁灭。

sentences.en: I can't tell where I am now.
sentences.zh: 我现在分不清我在哪里了。

sentences.en: This is my city.
sentences.zh: 这是我的城市。

sentences.en: I don't know where I am.
sentences.zh: 我不知道我在哪。

sentences.en: You don't even recognize it?
sentences.zh: 你甚至认不出来了？

sentences.en: No, it's not recognizable for me to know where we choose three times.
sentences.zh: 不，它已经面目全非，我甚至不知道我们选了三次什么地方。

sentences.en: At one point, we went into a building, and I realized that he had been arrested in that building.
sentences.zh: 有一次，我们走进一栋建筑，我意识到他曾在那栋建筑里被捕过。

sentences.en: Could you tell me what were the grounds of his arrest, and what do you know about that story?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我他被捕的理由是什么吗？关于这个故事你了解多少？

sentences.en: Yeah, so Haq was fingered by a neighbor who knew him and who went to ISIS and pointed out that he had worked for U.S.
sentences.zh: 对，哈克是被一个认识他的邻居告发了，那人跑去ISIS指出他曾为美军工作过。

sentences.en: forces.
sentences.zh: 部队。

sentences.en: He was picked up by the religious police, the Hizba, and driven to this building next to a church that had been turned into the headquarters of their morality police.
sentences.zh: 他被宗教警察“伊斯巴”抓走，带到了这座建筑，它挨着一座教堂，教堂已经被改成了他们道德警察的总部。

sentences.en: Haq, is this where you were kept?
sentences.zh: 哈克，这就是你被关押的地方吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, they bring us here.
sentences.zh: 对，他们把我们带到这里。

sentences.en: They say, you sit.
sentences.zh: 他们说，你们坐下。

sentences.en: It was like four of us sitting here.
sentences.zh: 当时我们大约有四个人坐在这里。

sentences.en: We were sitting, then they say, we have to wait for the sheikh.
sentences.zh: 我们坐着，然后他们说，我们得等谢赫。

sentences.en: The sheikh is like the judge of the Islamic state.
sentences.zh: 谢赫就像是伊斯兰国的法官。

sentences.en: He was taken in to see a Sharia judge, and he was interrogated basically overnight.
sentences.zh: 他被带去见一名伊斯兰法官，基本上连夜接受了审讯。

sentences.en: So we were like waiting, but in anxiety and awareness, it's killing me.
sentences.zh: 所以我们在等待，内心充满了焦虑和恐惧，这折磨得我快疯了。

sentences.en: And what had you heard they might do to you?
sentences.zh: 你当时听说他们会怎么对你？

sentences.en: What would you think?
sentences.zh: 你觉得会怎样？

sentences.en: Just kill me.
sentences.zh: 直接杀了我。

sentences.en: You thought you might die?
sentences.zh: 你以为自己会死？

sentences.en: It's not about death.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是死的问题。

sentences.en: It's about very humiliated death, you know, like sheep.
sentences.zh: 这是一种极其屈辱的死法，你知道的，就像待宰的羔羊。

sentences.en: He was extremely frightened that they would find out that he'd actually been working with the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他极其害怕他们会发现他其实已经为美军工作了多年。

sentences.en: military for years.
sentences.zh: 军队。

sentences.en: So the desk was here.
sentences.zh: 所以桌子在这里。

sentences.en: As I entered, there was a desk.
sentences.zh: 我一进去，就有一张桌子。

sentences.en: There was another cushion here.
sentences.zh: 这里还有一个垫子。

sentences.en: The reason he was able to hide that is because that work had been in Baghdad, as opposed to in Mosul.
sentences.zh: 他之所以能够隐瞒这一点，是因为他的工作是在巴格达，而不是在摩苏尔。

sentences.en: He was then forced to sign a kind of confession, signing away, saying that if he tried to leave the city, the punishment would be that a member of his family would be executed.
sentences.zh: 然后他被迫签署了一份类似认罪书的文件，上面写着，如果他试图离开这座城市，惩罚就是他的一个家人将被处决。

sentences.en: Did he not look you up?
sentences.zh: 他没有搜查你吗？

sentences.en: Did you have photos of you and soldiers you had worked with on Facebook or anything?
sentences.zh: 你的脸书或其他地方，有没有你和曾共事士兵的合影？

sentences.en: Had he looked that up?
sentences.zh: 他查过这些吗？

sentences.en: Would he have caught you?
sentences.zh: 他本可以抓住你吗？

sentences.en: Because I've never forced anything like this up to this moment.
sentences.zh: 因为直到现在我也从未强迫过类似的事情。

sentences.en: And I don't want in the future because it would be against me.
sentences.zh: 而且我以后也不想这样，因为这对我自己不利。

sentences.en: As I am still in this country.
sentences.zh: 因为我还留在这个国家。

sentences.en: And this is why you won't let me use your real name?
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么你不让我用你的真名？

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And is it because you think they will maybe be back one day or?
sentences.zh: 是因为你觉得他们也许有一天会回来，还是……？

sentences.en: Them or anything.
sentences.zh: 无论是他们还是别的什么人。

sentences.en: As long as I'm in this country, everything is compromised.
sentences.zh: 只要我还留在这个国家，一切都充满变数。

sentences.en: So one of the interesting things about Haq is I've worked extremely closely with him.
sentences.zh: 关于哈克，有趣的一点是，我和他合作得非常紧密。

sentences.en: We have slept on the rooftops of abandoned buildings on the outskirts of Mosul.
sentences.zh: 我们曾睡在摩苏尔郊区废弃建筑的屋顶上。

sentences.en: We've seen pretty much every phase of this battle together.
sentences.zh: 这场战役的几乎每一个阶段我们都一起见证过。

sentences.en: But even though his home has been liberated in eastern Mosul, he has never taken me home to see his wife or his kids.
sentences.zh: 但尽管他在东摩苏尔的家已经解放，他却从未带我回家见他的妻子或孩子。

sentences.en: He doesn't want to be seen with Americans.
sentences.zh: 他不想被看到和美国人在一起。

sentences.en: He doesn't want to be seen texting on his phone in English.
sentences.zh: 他不想被看到在手机上用英文发信息。

sentences.en: Texting.
sentences.zh: 发信息。

sentences.en: Because the people now are a mixture of either they were supporters of ISIS members
sentences.zh: 因为现在的人很复杂，要么他们曾是ISIS成员的支持者

sentences.en: or people who have, they've felt on themselves.
sentences.zh: 要么是那些感到自身难保的人。

sentences.en: They think that it's not secured yet.
sentences.zh: 他们认为这里还不够安全。

sentences.en: Mosul is not secured yet and it will never be.
sentences.zh: 摩苏尔现在还不够安全，而且永远都不会安全。

sentences.en: Haq knows this place as well as anyone and he feels that there are infiltrators in his own neighborhood, just like the neighbor that fingered him to ISIS before.
sentences.zh: 哈克对这个地方了如指掌，他觉得自己的邻里之间也潜伏着内奸，就像之前向ISIS告发他的那个邻居一样。

sentences.en: Those people are still there and those people could someday come back and be in power again and harm him and his family.
sentences.zh: 那些人依然还在，那些人总有一天可能会卷土重来，重新掌权，并伤害他和他的家人。

sentences.en: It's not over with the defeat of ISIS caliphate troops because they will always be there in some form and they will be back in another version of, if not ISIS, something else.
sentences.zh: 击败ISIS哈里发部队并不意味着结束，因为他们总会以某种形式存在，并且会以另一种面目卷土重来，即使不是ISIS，也会是别的什么。

sentences.en: Because it's really hard to take off an ideology.
sentences.zh: 因为要消除一种意识形态真的很难。

sentences.en: It's very easy to take off troops, buildings, but thoughts and philosophy and ideology, this can live forever.
sentences.zh: 消灭军队、摧毁建筑很容易，但思想、哲学和意识形态却能永存。

sentences.en: Saying thoughts can live forever.
sentences.zh: 这说明思想可以永存。

sentences.en: All that suggests to me is that the city, even though in title, it's perhaps now back under Iraqi rule, it is far from secure.
sentences.zh: 所有这些向我表明，这座城市尽管名义上或许已经回到伊拉克政府的管辖之下，但远谈不上安全。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: Well, good afternoon, everyone.
sentences.zh: 大家下午好。

sentences.en: The news of the day is that, as I think you already know, we'll be on health care next week.
sentences.zh: 今天的新闻是，我想大家已经知道了，我们下周将审议医疗法案。

sentences.en: Senate Majority Leader Mitch McConnell is returning from the 4th of July holiday with a promise to introduce another version of his health care bill,
sentences.zh: 参议院多数党领袖米奇·麦康奈尔在独立日假期结束后归来，承诺将推出另一版医改法案，

sentences.en: with the current one facing too much opposition from within his own party.
sentences.zh: 因为目前的版本遭到了来自他党内内部的强烈反对。

sentences.en: We'll be laying out a revised version of the repeal and replace effort, the text of that, on Thursday morning.
sentences.zh: 我们将在周四上午公布废除并替代法案的修订版及其具体文本。

sentences.en: Republicans can afford to lose just two votes on the bill, and 10 Republican senators said they wouldn't support it.
sentences.zh: 共和党人在该法案上只能承受两票的反叛，而已有10名共和党参议员表示不会支持它。

sentences.en: McConnell's plan for passing the health care bill and the rest of his agenda will require that the Senate cut into its annual August recess,
sentences.zh: 麦康奈尔通过医改法案及其他议程的计划需要参议院缩短其年度八月份休会期，

sentences.en: a step the Senate hasn't taken since 1994.
sentences.zh: 这是参议院自1994年以来从未采取过的举措。

sentences.en: We will be in session the first two weeks of AuguSt.
sentences.zh: 我们在八月份的前两周将照常开会。

sentences.en: That we had originally anticipated not being here, we will be here.
sentences.zh: 我们原本预计不在这里，但我们现在得留在这里。

sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。
